entities.name: ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network in response to an ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message to provide requested ESM information.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for the message.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer associated with the ESM procedure.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: Identifies the procedure transaction for the ESM procedure.

entities.name: ESM information response message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE.

entities.name: Access point name
entities.description: Optional IE containing the access point name for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Optional IE containing protocol configuration parameters.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: Optional IE containing extended protocol configuration parameters.

entities.name: ESM information exchange
entities.description: Procedure where UE provides ESM information to the network in response to an ESM INFORMATION REQUEST.

relations.description: ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message contains the mandatory Protocol discriminator IE.
ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message contains the mandatory EPS bearer identity IE.
ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message contains the mandatory Procedure transaction identity IE.
ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message contains the mandatory Message type IE.
ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message may contain the optional Access point name IE.
ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message may contain the optional Protocol configuration options IE.
ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message may contain the optional Extended protocol configuration options IE.
ESM information exchange procedure includes sending the ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message.
